caption: Usage before the test: Clips 0 / 300, the Pro allowance of 300 clips a month.
API access is a separate prepaid balance, not part of Pro: current balance $0.00, $5 in free credits only after adding a card, and no API keys created.
Create shorts on our own 2:57 review video: with Moments set to Best, the dialog promises Generate ~7 shorts.
The run produced 4 shorts, not the estimated 7. The first, When you should not buy Chatwith (0:11), got a virality score of 75/100 and a transcript.
Usage after generation: Clips 4 / 300, so each short counted as one clip.
The clip menu offers only Rename and Delete next to edit, download and schedule; we found no separate transcript or SRT export.
The editor works from the transcript: the highlighted lines on the right match the caption blocks on the timeline of the 0:11 clip.
